moments.title: August Bank Holiday Monday
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday, also known as the Late Summer Bank Holiday, takes place on Monday, August 31st, in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, marking a final long weekend of summer for many.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Extra day off tomorrow! What are your August Bank Holiday plans? Making the most of the last of summer?

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: Planning to travel this Bank Holiday Monday? Expect busier roads and check public transport schedules as many services will be operating on a reduced timetable.

moments.title: Premier League Sunday action
moments.blurb: Today sees several Premier League clashes, including Chelsea vs Brighton, Leeds vs Brentford, Sunderland vs Fulham, and Manchester United vs Ipswich Town.

angles.name: Match Day Buzz
angles.copy: Premier League Sunday! Who are you watching today? Big games including Chelsea v Brighton and Man Utd v Ipswich. Get your predictions in!

angles.name: Sunday Football
angles.copy: Kicking off this afternoon: Chelsea take on Brighton, while Leeds face Brentford. What's your top match to watch?

moments.title: Exeter City vs Barnet
moments.blurb: Exeter City will play their next League Two match at home against Barnet on Tuesday, September 1st, at St James Park.

angles.name: Grecians Home Game
angles.copy: The Grecians are back at St James Park on Tuesday! Exeter City host Barnet in League Two. Who's heading down to cheer them on?

angles.name: Exeter Football
angles.copy: Big match for Exeter City coming up this Tuesday, 1st September, as they welcome Barnet to St James Park for a League Two fixture. Kick-off is 7:45 PM.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean still #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the top spot on the UK Official Singles Chart for a record 23rd non-consecutive week.

angles.name: Chart Dominance
angles.copy: Unstoppable! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is still number one in the UK for an incredible 23rd week. Are you still loving it?

angles.name: Longest Running #1
angles.copy: History in the making! 'Rein Me In' continues its reign as the longest-running Number 1 single in UK chart history. What a track!

moments.title: Ultra Naté climbs to #2
moments.blurb: HUGEL, Imael Angel & Ultra Naté's 'Movin' To The Sun' hits a new peak at Number 2 on the UK Official Singles Chart, marking Ultra Naté's highest-charting single to date.

angles.name: Dance Chart Success
angles.copy: Massive news for dance music! Ultra Naté is back in a big way, hitting Number 2 on the UK charts with 'Movin' To The Sun'. What a summer anthem!

angles.name: Ultra Naté Record
angles.copy: 29 years after 'Free', Ultra Naté breaks her own chart record! 'Movin' To The Sun' is her highest-charting UK single EVER at Number 2. Incredible!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bebe Rexha
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Bebe Rexha, known for hits like 'Meant to Be' and co-writing 'The Monster', turns 37 today.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the incredible Bebe Rexha, who turns 37 today! What's your favourite track from her?

angles.name: Bebe Rexha Fact
angles.copy: Did you know Bebe Rexha co-wrote Eminem and Rihanna's Grammy-winning single 'The Monster'? Happy 37th Birthday to a true talent!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Paul Oakenfold
moments.blurb: Legendary British trance DJ and record producer Paul Oakenfold celebrates his 63rd birthday today.

angles.name: DJ Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the iconic DJ Paul Oakenfold! What's your favourite Oakenfold set or remix?

angles.name: Oakenfold Influence
angles.copy: A true pioneer! Paul Oakenfold, one of the most influential DJs in trance music, is 63 today. Still spinning those incredible tracks!

angles.name: God Save The Queen

angles.name: Surf Rock Icon
